title: How can I see which model Gemini uses?
question: I use Gemini free version. Since a few days ago, I can't see which models it uses: How can I see which model Gemini uses?
answer: This is documented at https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17004136?hl=en Auto will be the default setting for users without a Google AI plan ... Most prompts will go to Flash-Lite, our fastest model. Prompts that need deeper reasoning may go to Flash or Pro. ... If smart model selection is turned off, chats for users without an AI plan will use Flash-Lite for all responses. Note that even a Plus user (practically free with various promos) will soon also lose the ability to pick Pro option
